columns.name: deviation
columns.why: Every writer asserts its derived bound. Last-bit errors vary across machines; stored deviations are evidence rather than golden truth.

columns.name: bound
columns.why: The original predeclared acceptance limit is fixed for this case. Every measurement must meet both this limit and its freshly derived local bound; rewriting records cannot increase the accepted error.

columns.name: derived_bound
columns.why: The bound derived before this measurement, including local special functions and quadrature estimates. Record it at full precision; the test and writer enforce it independently of the fixed limit.
